posts.summary:
I got pretty nerd sniped listening to
@TheStalwart
 talking about El Niño in the latest Odd Lots podcast..
So, decided to build a full blown situation monitor for this called El Neenyo (elneenyo dot com)
Complete with live news, reports, history, glossary, primer, why you should care, hourly data tracking and more.
So next time, El Niño comes up on the lunch or dinner table and people want to know what's it about, point them to this resource.
As always, feedback welcome!
